services.name: Lime mortar repointing
services.blurb: Old joints raked out by hand and refilled with lime mortar softer than your old brick.

services.name: Chimney rebuild
services.blurb: Loose chimney tops taken down to sound brick and relaid course by course to match.

services.name: Chimney crown
services.blurb: A new sloped crown with a drip edge so water runs off instead of into the brick.

services.name: Brick replacement
services.blurb: Spalled and cracked bricks cut out and replaced with salvaged brick close in size and color.

services.name: Limestone foundation repair
services.blurb: Old limestone foundations repointed and loose stones reset, common under Cincinnati houses before 1920.

services.name: Hillside retaining walls
services.blurb: Stone and block walls rebuilt on the slopes, with drainage behind them so they stay put.

services.name: Front stoops & steps
services.blurb: Sagging brick and stone stoops taken apart, given a solid base and laid back level.

services.name: Mortar matching
services.blurb: Test panels of sand, lime and tint made beside your wall until the new joint disappears.

services.name: Paint removal from brick
services.blurb: Old paint taken off brick with low-pressure methods that leave the brick face intact.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our 1880s Italianate in Over-the-Rhine had joints you could push a finger into. Owen made three mortar samples on the back wall and let us pick. You cannot tell which joints are new.
reviews.name: Hannah V.

reviews.text: Another mason wanted to use a hard modern mortar. Owen explained why that cracks soft old brick and showed us the spalled spots where someone had done it before.
reviews.name: Dave K.

reviews.text: The top of our chimney was leaning toward the neighbor. They took it down to solid brick, relaid it and put on a proper crown. The flashing leak is gone too.
reviews.name: Marisa T.

reviews.text: The retaining wall on our hill was bowing out over the sidewalk. Rebuilt with gravel and a drain behind it. Two wet springs later it has not moved.
reviews.name: Greg L.

reviews.text: Front stoop had sunk about two inches on one side. They took it apart, poured a footing and laid the same brick back. Looks like it always did, only level.
reviews.name: Shonda P.

reviews.text: Someone painted our brick red in the 70s. They tested a small patch first, then took the whole front off without scarring the brick.
reviews.name: Ellen R.

proof.guarantee: If new mortar cracks or comes loose within two years, we come back and repoint it at no charge.
